_about: Hand-written facts per profile that the preset and pi config do not hold. tools/model_cards.py renders models/<profile>.md from this file, the preset, the pi config copy and the speed sweep. Edit this file, not the .md pages.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.base: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL), hybrid Gated DeltaNet + MoE, vision
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.card_sampling: thinking general: temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, presence 1.5; precise coding: temp 0.6, presence 0 (not used; the preset uses thinking general since 2026-11-04)
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.template: enable_thinking, preserve_thinking; llama.cpp logs preserved reasoning
config_results: 2026-11-01 config pass (`llm-eval-data/2026-11-01-config-pass/report.md`, desktop 1.8 GB with Slack and Brave open): preset as written left 801 MiB free at 90% fill (223 under the 1,024 MiB floor)
Adopted `load-mode = none` (C6): score 22.9 → 21.8 s (4.9% faster), prefill 1,481 → 1,716 t/s, decode 85.8 → 87.5 t/s, lowest free 801 → 777 MiB
Adopted `image-min-tokens = 1024` (C3), pending the image check (D2): loads, the Qwen-VL grounding warning is gone, lowest free 801 → 814 MiB, speed unchanged

gemma-4-26b-a4b-it.base: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (bartowski Q4_K_L), MoE, sliding-window attention, vision
gemma-4-26b-a4b-it.template: enable_thinking (default off; preset sets reasoning on); earlier thinking kept only on tool-call turns
known_issues: image tokens capped at 512 by ubatch 512 (C2: 1152 lifts it but leaves 855 MiB at 90% fill)
tokenizer: `</s>` and `<|tool_response>` type overrides at load
config_results: 2026-11-01 config pass (`llm-eval-data/2026-11-01-config-pass/report.md`, desktop 1.8 GB with Slack and Brave open): preset as written left 1,315 MiB free at 90% fill (291 over the 1,024 MiB floor)

Not adopted: `ubatch-size = 1152` (C2) lifts the 512 image-token cap to 1,120 (no cap line in the load log) and prefill 3,830 → 4,091 t/s, but costs 460 MiB (lowest free 855, under the 1,024 MiB floor)
Template (C10): thinking on (`<|think|>` in the system turn); earlier thinking dropped on plain turns, as the card asks

qwen3.8-27b-unsloth-q4-mtp.base: Qwen3.8 27B (Unsloth UD-Q4_K_M) with the separate MTP Q4_0 drafter; the file also has its own MTP layer
